{{recipesummary|category=Cookie recipes|yield=10 dozen cookies|time=1/2 hour + baking time|difficulty=2}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Desserts| Desserts]]

==Ingredients==
* 3 sticks (12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 340 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], softened to room temperature
* 1 box (16 oz / 450 g) [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:White Sugar|white sugar]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]
* 2 cups all-purpose [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 2 teaspoons [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
* 12 oz (340 g) semi-sweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate Chips|chocolate chips]]
* 8 cups [[Cookbook:Rolled Oats|rolled oats]]

==Procedure==

# [[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] butter and both kinds of sugar with an electric [[Cookbook:Mixer|mixer]] until smooth.
# Combine the water, eggs, and  vanilla in a separate container.
# Gradually beat the egg mixture into the butter mixture until smooth.
# Combine the flour and baking soda, then sift this mixture into the butter mixture. Mix to form a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]].
# Use a sturdy mixing spoon to stir in the chocolate chips and 6 cups of the oats.
# Stir in additional oats until the dough is stiff and almost crumbly.
# If desired, chill dough until ready to bake.
# Scoop teaspoon-sized balls of dough and place on a greased or [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]]-lined [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a preheated 350°F (175C) [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] for about 10 minutes, until a [[Cookbook:Skewer|toothpick]] inserted into the cookies comes out clean.

==Notes, tips, variations==

=== Notes ===
* The whole recipe can be halved (but you'll just need to make more).
* The measurements for the vanilla and baking soda are guesses, so you may need to adjust them.
* Depending on the oven and the cookie sheets, you may need to adjust the temperature and/or time.

=== Ingredient substitutions ===
* Add more chocolate chips (or other small candy) if desired.
* Substitute other "filler" (wheat germ, flaxseed, [[Cookbook:Nuts and Seeds|nuts]], seeds, etc.) for some of the oatmeal.
* Whatever you do to adjust the chocolate chips and oatmeal, make sure the resulting dough is very stiff—this helps make the cookies chewy.

=== Allergies and sensitivities ===
If you have allergies and sensitivities, you are probably already familiar with making adjustments to your recipes. Sometimes, these adjustments change the taste of the resulting food. The following adjustments have all been successful:

==== Dairy-free ====

* Use non-dairy butter substitutes (e.g., Earth Balance).
* Use chocolate that is made without milk.

==== Gluten-free ====

* Substitute a gluten free flour blend (e.g., Bob's Red Mill) for the all-purpose flour.
